## Composer
 - A panel next to the editor for PHP packages: search Packagist and tap **Install**
 - No terminal — `composer require / remove / update / install` runs inside the proot Debian with live output in the log box
 - Curated list of common packages (Essentials, Frameworks, Database, Web, Dev) grouped by category, plus a free-form composer command box
 - Project actions: install all, update, validate, dump-autoload and show direct dependencies
 - Resolves the real project by walking up to the nearest `composer.json`, or pick a folder by hand
 - Buttons for clearing the log and sending a command to a real terminal when needed
 - Missing PHP or Composer is installed automatically before the first package
 - Every widget is built in code on a `ContextThemeWrapper` of the platform DayNight theme and every colour is read from a theme attribute, so the panel follows light/dark without shipping a single resource of its own
